thread.title: Netflix Stock Falls Below Key Trading Level As Bears Battle Bulls

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Netflix Stock Falls Below Key Trading Level As Bears Battle Bulls

organizations.name: netflix stock falls below key trading level as bears battle bulls netflix

text:
Netflix ( NFLX ) stock closed below its 50-day moving average on Monday in a bearish technical trading sign.
X Shares of the internet television network had fallen below that key support level in the previous two trading sessions, but managed to close above it on both days. However, on the stock market today , shares closed below their 50-day moving average for the first time this year amid a broad market sell-off. Netflix fell 5.1% to 280.29 on Monday. In intraday trading it had been down as much as 6.9% to 275.05.
The stock has fallen 16% from its all-time high of 333.98 on March 12, though it's still well-extended from a 204.48 flat-base entry. Netflix currently ranks No. 3 on the IBD 50 list of top-performing growth stocks.
Wall Street Is Torn Wall Street analysts have debated the company's valuation of late following its steep run-up. Bulls point to healthy subscriber growth, massive global scale and strong brand. Bears bring up its heavy spending on content, large negative free cash flow and growing competition.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Earlier Monday, Baird analyst William Power reiterated his neutral rating on Netflix, but upped his price target to 280 from 240. Power said the risk/reward on Netflix stock is balanced due to "continued high expectations and valuation."
The company has built a catalog of exclusive, original content as Hollywood studios increasingly look to create their own direct-to-consumer streaming video services. Its competition now includes Amazon ( AMZN ), Hulu and Time Warner ' s ( TWX ) HBO, but Walt Disney ( DIS ) and Apple ( AAPL ) are set to join the fray soon.
Netflix reportedly is interested in buying French movie studio EuropaCorp, best known for such films as "Taken," "Lucy" and "Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets." A deal could be announced in the next few weeks, according to French media reports. EuropaCorp has a market cap of about $80 million.
The next catalyst for Netflix stock is likely to be its first-quarter earnings report, scheduled for release after the market close on April 16.
